rachel_pm: Quick sync 30 need a pragmatic upgrade playbook for Private (VPC/on-prem) that minimizes customer impact.
kevin_eng: Idea: define a "safety profile" per customer (default, conservative, airgapped). Safety profile drives installer behavior (e.g., auto-canary thresholds, require manual approval for major migrations).
sarah_pd: Customers want clear SLAs for upgrade windows and an explicit maintenance-mode toggle. Also ask for an option to pin runtime+model images per-namespace.
jordan_netops: From network side: publish three shipped modes (static-egress, vpc-peering, proxy-forwarding) + a migration checklist for each. Key ask: preserving outbound IPs during node rotation.
leo_ops: Ops must be able to run a checkpoint snapshot (KV+config) in <30s and trigger a one-command revert. Also make progress observable (percent complete + current canary cohort).
maya_support: Support needs a pre-flight diag bundle and a post-upgrade verification checklist that runs automatically: auth test, quick infer, telemetry heartbeat. Also a manual abort path.
kevin_eng: Technical constraints: KV schema changes across major model updates require migration hooks. We'll ship a manifest schema for pre/post hooks and a dry-run mode. Example manifest (docs): {"migration_version":"2.0","pre_hooks":["snapshot_kv","pause_ingress"],"post_hooks":["smoke_infer","reconcile_routes"]}.
rachel_pm: Launch minimum: (1) installer with --maintenance flag, (2) snapshot + revert tooling, (3) network quickstarts for each mode, (4) smoke tests and runbook, (5) 3-customer pilot.
jordan_netops: Also include firewall rule templates for common on-prem devices and a small reconcile script customers can run after node cycling.
leo_ops: I'll prototype snapshot/revert CLI and a healthcheck orchestrator this sprint. Target alpha in staging.
kevin_eng: I'll own the migration manifest spec and package split doc. Will include signature verification and semver rules. PR by Tue.
sarah_pd: I'll shortlist pilot customers (2 regulated, 1 high-traffic) and write success criteria (error budget, latency delta, rollback frequency).
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging/private-surge-upgrade-alpha to env:staging at 2024-06-12T18:00:00Z.
rachel_pm: Thanks team 30 check-in Fri 09:00 for PR and demos. Ping here if blockers.
